_meta.name: default-style-lock
_meta.purpose: Conservative fallback Style Lock when the user provides no brand spec. Safe for any category / region; never spectacular but never wrong.
_meta.usage: Read by Claude at SKILL.md Step 4 when (a) campaign task detected AND (b) no brand colors/fonts/VI supplied. Apply category_overrides.color_palette for the detected category, then apply region adjustments per campaign-style-lock.md section 6. Assemble the final 10 fields via prepend_template and prepend the rendered LOCK block verbatim to every image prompt in the set.
_meta.single_source_of_truth: Field definitions and region table live in references/campaign-style-lock.md. This file holds ONLY the default values + category color branches. Do not duplicate region/lock semantics here.

visual_direction: commercial product photography, consistent across the entire set

color_palette.note: Neutral, high-contrast, marketplace-safe. Override accent via category_overrides or user brand color.

color_temperature: neutral, balanced white balance ~5500K, no strong warm/cool cast

typography.cjk_fallback: Source Han Sans / Noto Sans CJK (add when target market includes CN/JP/KR/SEA)

background_system: clean light gray studio sweep, subtle gradient from #F5F5F5 to #E8E8E8, no distracting props
lighting_system: soft diffused daylight from top-left, gentle falloff, even illumination, subtle rim light on right edge
layout_system: rule of thirds, product centered or center-left, generous whitespace, left-aligned text blocks
icon_system: thin-line minimal icons, 2px stroke, 4px corner radius, monochrome in accent color #0066CC
product_presentation: front 3/4 angle, product occupies 60-70% of frame, no crop on edges, sharp focus throughout
locked_immutable: color palette, typography, background hue, lighting direction, icon style, product angle

category_overrides.note: When the detected product category matches a key below, override ONLY color_palette and color_temperature; keep all other default fields. These are conservative commercial defaults, not stylized extremes.

electronics.color_temperature: cool, blue-white tint ~6500K, clean precise feel

beauty.color_temperature: warm, soft golden tint ~4500K, gentle glow
